about.title: About NazmHub
about.intro: NazmHub (نظم) is a home for writers and readers in Urdu and English. Publish your stories, articles, essays and poetry — or just come to read.

sections.heading: Two languages, one home
sections.body: Write and read in Urdu and English, with full right-to-left support for Urdu. Switch languages anytime — your words stay yours.

sections.heading: What you can publish
sections.body: Stories, articles, essays, poetry, and everyday thoughts. From a two-line nazm to a long afsana, everything has a place here.

sections.heading: Kids' Corner
sections.body: A special shelf of stories reviewed by our team before young readers can see them. Safe, simple, and full of wonder.

sections.heading: A respectful community
sections.body: We protect original work and keep the space kind: clear rules, human-reviewed moderation, and a fair appeals process.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NazmHub collects as little as possible to run the site — and never sells your data.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Account details you give us (email, username, birth year for age-appropriate access). Content you publish (stories, comments, profile). Technical basics stored in your browser (theme, language, login session) via our auth provider, Supabase.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: To run your account, show your work, keep the community safe through moderation, and improve the site. We do not sell your personal information to anyone.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: Readers under 16 get a read-only Kids' Corner with reviewed stories. We ask for a birth year at signup so younger accounts get age-appropriate access.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies and browser storage for login, language, and theme preferences. If advertising is enabled in the future, third-party vendors including Google may use cookies to serve ads; you can opt out via Google's Ad Settings.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Edit your profile anytime in Settings. To delete your account or ask about your data, reach us through the Contact page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach us depends on what you need:

items.heading: Report a story or comment
items.body: Every story page has a Report button. Our moderators review every report.

items.heading: Appeal a moderation decision
items.body: If your work was removed or limited, you can appeal from your dashboard. A human reviews every appeal.

items.heading: Account and privacy questions
items.body: Manage your profile in Settings. For anything else, email us — our email address is coming soon.

contact.note: We read everything, but we're a small team — please allow a few days for a reply.
